sentences.text:
The prayer in the writ petition is made for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding in connection with SC/ST P.S. Case No.26 of 2024 --1-- W.P. (Cr.) No. 968 of 2024 dated 04.07.2024 for the alleged offences under Sections 341,
498A, 323, 504 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and Sections 3(i)(r)(s) of Scheduled Caste Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Judicial Commissioner - II, Ranchi.

entities.text: Scheduled Caste Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that respondent No.2 is the wife of petitioner No.5.
He submits that the case is arising out of the matrimonial dispute and the petitioner Nos.1 to 4 are the father-in-law, mother-in-law and brother-in-law respectively.

He submits that now a good sense has prevailed between the parties and the petitioner No.5 and respondent No.2 are residing together and the dispute has been resolved and in view of that the compromise has reached between the parties and for that I.A. No.12194 of 2024 has been filed for compromise.
4. Learned counsel appearing for the respondent State submits that the matter is arising out of the matrimonial dispute and from the I.A. it transpires that the compromise is there.
5. Learned counsel appearing for the respondent No.2 submits that he has appeared by way of filing the vakalatnama and he accepts the submission of learned counsel appearing for the petitioners.
He submits that the said IA has been separately affidavited by both the sides and husband and wife are residing together along with the entire family member.
He submits that the respondent No.2 does not want to proceed further in the matter.

6. In view of the above and considering that the matter is arising out of the matrimonial dispute and the conjugal life has been restored by --2-- W.P. (Cr.) No. 968 of 2024 way of compromise and there is joint compromise and both are residing happily and there is no societal interest involve in this case and further considering the judgment of Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Narinder Singh & Ors.

Versus State of Punjab &
Anr., reported in (2014) 6 SCC 466 and further in the case of "Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab &
Anr." reported in (2012) 10 SCC 303, as such entire criminal proceeding in connection with SC/ST P.S. Case No.26 of 2024 dated 04.07.2024 pending in the Court of learned Additional Judicial Commissioner - II, Ranchi
